USER-VISIBLE, AUDIT MISSED IT, and it cannot be a string swap. The banner NAME rendered beside every avatar (js/dist/forum.js:236, :967) is passed through verbatim from the source-board scrape, so a Spanish page prints 'administrator', 'moderator', 'to the moon!'. Fixing it means adding a label lookup — e.g. a LABEL_KEY map from the same five lowercase names to 'local-looksmax-userinfo.forum.banner_name.<slug>' and returning a 'labelKey' alongside 'name', which the JS then resolves with a fallback to the raw name for banners the scrape has not seen. That is a new field on the payload plus a JS branch, not a find/replace. Roughly 12 lines across two files.

USER-VISIBLE, AUDIT MISSED IT. This string is printed raw in the carried-over tooltip (js/dist/forum.js:327 -> forum.legacy.title {joined}). It comes from the source-board scrape and its format is not known to be a parseable date, so it cannot be handed to lmxI18n.date() blind. What it would take: one query against userinfo_profiles.legacy_joined to establish the stored format; if it parses, format it in Presenter with a locale-independent ISO string and let the JS run monthYear() over it.
